messages:
maria (support): Escalation: AcmeCorp dedicated pool dp-58 throughput dropped ~60% since 09:12 UTC. Customers seeing 429s + p50 latency ~3s. Ticket INC-8791. Pls triage.
joel (eng-runtime): On it. Any recent deploys to dp-58? Autoscaler events?
deploy-bot: :rocket: deploy finished: service/inference dp-58 runtime 2023.11.3 at 2023-11-14T09:05:12Z
li (sre): Seeing inflight queue depth spike on gpux-12 nodes. Prefill wait times up, continuous-batcher collapsed to tiny batches (1-3 requests). Logs: 
```
2023-11-14T09:11:34Z [batcher] node=gpux-12 prefill_wait_ms=1280 batch_size=2 pack_efficiency=0.12
2023-11-14T09:11:35Z [batcher] node=gpux-12 batch_dispatch_ms=1450 inflight=48
```
joel (eng-runtime): Sounds like the packer is failing for lots of short concurrent requests — many small prompts breaking packing heuristic. Current runtime config: max_batch_tokens=2048, min_batch_tokens=8, pack_window_ms=8.
tom (account): Customer says they switched to chunked streaming and ramped concurrent calls this morning.
maria (support): Repro steps from customer:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","prompt":"short","max_tokens":800}' &
# repeated ~200x across a few hosts
```
joel (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation: force packer strategy to 'aggressive' and relax scheduler quantum. Suggested env patches:
```
CONT_BATCHER_PACK_STRATEGY=aggressive
SCHED_QUANTUM_MS=32
```
Apply to canary nodes: `kubectl set env ds/rt-serve -n dp-58 CONT_BATCHER_PACK_STRATEGY=aggressive` then `kubectl rollout restart ds/rt-serve -n dp-58 --selector=canary=true`.
li (sre): Rolling canary to 2 nodes in dp-58 now and temporarily increasing pool size by +2 GPUs to absorb burst.
ops-bot: Autoscaler: pool dp-58 scaled +2 GPUs at 2023-11-14T09:28:10Z (trigger=manual by li).
joel (eng-runtime): If throughput doesn't recover within 5m we'll rollback the 2023.11.3 deploy and revert scheduler experiments. Also will capture trace spans for pack+dispatch.
maria (support): Notified customer that we're applying mitigations and may rollback. Updating INC-8791. :thumbsup:
